about: Official state unclaimed-property search portals (cluster K12, C91; packages/domain/118-found-money.js). A state row ships only when its search URL was verified on the state's own official site or in the state treasurer's own releases. States without a verified row here are searched through the NAUPA directory (unclaimed.org, the National Association of Unclaimed Property Administrators), which links to each state's official program and to MissingMoney.com for a multi-state search. Searching and claiming are always free; anyone charging a fee to search is not the state. Claim timelines are stated only where the state itself states them — where it does not, the packet says so instead of guessing.

directory.checked_how: Read on unclaimed.org itself on 2026-10-12: NAUPA's site links to the official government unclaimed property program for each state and province, and names MissingMoney.com as its free multi-state search for participating states.
directory.name: NAUPA unclaimed property directory

states.checked_how: Read on the portal itself (icash.illinoistreasurer.gov) on 2026-10-12: it searches by name, starts a claim, and checks a claim's status by Claim ID. Property is returned at no cost with proper identification. The same Treasurer's office runs Illinois Money Match (packages/offers/unclaimed-programs.json).
states.timeline_note: The portal does not promise a processing time; a submitted claim can be tracked on the same site with its Claim ID.
